chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurara, who said:
I performed ablution one day and did not wash my manhood, then I prayed. So I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and he said: 'Wash your manhood and repeat your prayer.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one forgets to wash the penis during wudu?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the Imami scholarly consensus that washing the penis (ghasl al-dhakara) is an integral component of wudu rather than merely a recommended act, as evidenced by Imam al-Sadiq’s directive to repeat the prayer. It underscores the strictness of ritual purity in Shia jurisprudence, where the omission of this specific cleansing invalidates the subsequent act of worship. The hadith serves as a primary textual basis for distinguishing between minor impurities requiring full wudu and those requiring only ghusl.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Zurara who said,
‘I performed Ablution (Wudhu) one day and did not wash my manhood. Then I Prayed. So I asked Abu Abdullahasws, and heasws said: ‘Wash your manhood and repeat the Salaat’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn ’Udhaynah from Zurarah who has said the following: “
One day I took Wudu’ but forgot to wash my urethra clean; then I performed Salah (prayer). I asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about it.
